entities.name: P0DOB6
observations: Reviewed Lactococcus lactis ATP-dependent 6-phosphofructokinase; exact full-sequence match to the query (340 aa, 100% identity and coverage).
Catalyzes the first committed step of glycolysis and forms a homotetramer in the cytoplasm.

entities.name: Magnesium ion
observations: Mg2+ is the curated cofactor for the ATP-dependent 6-phosphofructokinase reaction.

entities.name: Canonical glycolysis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes glycolytic step 3: phosphorylation of fructose 6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.
